what: On hover, the button letters slide left by 1.35rem and tilt −28° while disappearing, staggered .018s from the front (delayed .05s), and the same text enters from the right, tilted, and straightens (delayed .2s). Slide .6s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1), tilt .25s ease-out, opacity .15s. The background plate swells to 1.025×1.035 and is pressed down to .955×.925 on click

options.--fx-bg: Swelling background panel color (via style), default transparent — e.g. var(--kf-accent)
options.[data-fx-part=text]: Text to split (child, optional) — for a button mixed with icons, wrap only the text. If none, the whole text of the element

use: Join together

from.where: index.html .nh-btn (all yellow buttons — original button-099: --button-099-stagger .018s · out .05s · in .2s · hover-scale 1.025 1.035 · click .955 .925)
